speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given your symptoms of fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, I need to determine if this is an infection or malignancy. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, appetite, or the texture of your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those are concerning "B symptoms" often associated with lymphoma or metastatic disease. Have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits, or any history of gastrointestinal bleeding like black tarry stools?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic Gastric Cancer with supraclavicular lymph node involvement.
